replacements.before: **[Wobblini](wobblini.html)** is an eight-deck browser DJ instrument in progress: local tracks and original demo loops, per-deck cues, beat loops, EQ, filters and pan, A/THRU/B crossfader routing, and a shared filter wobble. Audio starts off. [Controls and MVP boundaries](docs/wobblini.md).
replacements.after: **[Wobblini](wobblini.html)** is an eight-deck browser DJ instrument in progress: scratchable records and wide track waveforms, local files and demo loops, selectable master with per-track SYNC, cues, beat loops, EQ, filters, and a geometric stereo pan/volume mixer. Audio starts off. [Controls and MVP boundaries](docs/wobblini.md).
